description: This file contains various shell functions related to platform-specific upgrade procedures in an OpenWrt build environment, including image verification, partition management, EFI system partition updates, and overall upgrade process.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the image partition layout matches the existing system, to determine if a full rewrite is necessary.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration data to a specified partition.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_efi_system_partition
methods.description: Handles updating the EFI system partition by copying EFI boot files from the new image.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the overall upgrade process, including partition management, image deployment, and EFI updates.
